text: Swirling patterns over a grey world map. Bright green swirls cover large parts of the oceans, especially the North Pacific and North Atlantic. A wide purple and white plume stretches from North Africa across the Atlantic toward the Caribbean. Orange and red patches appear over central and southern Africa, with small orange spots over South America and western North America. A white spiral storm sits off the south-east coast of the United States. This image shows no colour key.
